facts.value: Initializes aerial SpecialS by dividing self_vel.x by SpecialS.x3C_MIN_STICK_X_MOMENTUM without validation, overwriting self_vel.y with zero, selecting ftDk_MS_SpecialAirS with flags 0/start 0/rate 1/blend 0/NULL, calling ftAnim_8006EBA4, clearing cmd_vars[0], and assigning ftDk_SpecialLw_8010E148 to accessory4_cb. The division does not test stick input and is not necessarily attenuation.
facts.rationale: Independently verified repair of the librarian's proposed replacement for the baseline purpose; avoids external naming and unsupported numeric invariants.

evidence.why: Complete entry exposes quotient, overwrite, state arguments, helper call, reset, and callback assignment.

facts.value: Runs aerial SpecialS physics: every nonzero cmd_vars[0] enables subtraction of SpecialS.x44_AERIAL_GRAVITY from self_vel.y and clamping only when the result is strictly below negative common terminal velocity. Every invocation calls ftCommon_ApplyFrictionAir with SpecialS.x40_MOMENTUM_TRANSITION_MODIFIER; that helper writes x74_anim_vel.x, not self_vel.x. Its magnitude-equality branch selects -self_vel.x, otherwise it negates the supplied friction only for positive self_vel.x. The callback does not write cmd_vars[0] or change motion state; its trailing repeated test has an empty body. Unvalidated tuning does not imply universal damping or finite bounds.
facts.rationale: Replaces unqualified damping and external move naming with independently verified callee arithmetic and boundary conditions.

evidence.why: Conditional fall, unconditional friction, and empty final branch.
Exact friction branches and output field.
Gravity subtraction and strict lower-bound comparison.

facts.value: Maintains paired SpecialS callbacks. False ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining dispatches grounded completion through ft_8008A2BC and aerial completion through ftCo_Fall_Enter; grounded completion normally selects Wait but has common exceptional paths. Both IASA bodies are empty. Grounded collision selects ft_800827A0 for nonzero cmd_vars[0] and ft_80082708 for zero, invoking the SpecialAirS conversion on false. Aerial collision invokes the SpecialS conversion on nonzero ft_80081D0C. No local conversion is requested on the opposite result, without asserting absence of callee side effects. Both conversions change situation and pass cur_anim_frame at rate 1 using coll_mf, then restore effect hitlag callbacks only when x2219_b0 is true. They do not call the local entry routines.
facts.rationale: Independently verifies and tightens the librarian replacement: avoids unconditional ground completion, interpreted contact predicates, and a total-state preservation guarantee across collision callees.

evidence.why: Complete callback and transition control flow.
Situation conversion precedes current-frame state change.
Collision helper has position effects and an additional exceptional helper call.
